core_action: Steer to collect route cells, then carry enough cells into gaps so traversal consumes them automatically.
state_transition: running -> cell collected/stack grows -> hazard entered -> cells spent/bridge grows -> finish or insufficient-resource failure
session_loop: scan lanes -> steer -> collect -> read stack pressure -> commit to bridge -> finish/retry
goal_or_exit: Reach the finish platform with every required gap funded.
failure_pressure: Missing a collection line or paying an obstacle penalty can leave too few cells for the next gap.
randomness: None in the test slice; deterministic authored levels.
spectator_hook: The stack visibly rises during setup and collapses one unit at a time across a risky gap.
social_hook: Not included in the test slice.
content_burden: Moderate: levels vary lane patterns, gap budgets, penalties and curved-path presentation while the kernel remains fixed.

test_levels.design: A centered pickup line overfunds one short bridge; staying near the center is sufficient.
Pickups split across left and right lanes, penalties punish late steering, and two bridge budgets require active collection.

negative_cases: Do not claim the reference ad is a current hot-list winner.
Do not reuse source art, audio, layout, title or exact geometry.
Do not auto-win Level 2 when the player never steers.
Do not let bridge spending make the stack negative.
Do not claim Cocos Creator or Douyin DevTools verification from a browser preview.
